paragraphs: The E. coli and Salmonella outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts has ended [1]. The outbreak caused 77 illnesses and 6 hospitalizations across 16 states, with no deaths reported [1].

Family Farmstead Dairy is recalling all cheddar cheese products due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [3]. Fresh & Ready Foods LLC is recalling 2,414 Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches (4.6 oz) for potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [4]. Listeria can cause serious infections in young children, elderly people, and those with weakened immune systems [3][4].

BETTERBALLEN FOODS LLC issued a public health alert for Clear vacuum-packed 6-piece Bami Rolls with "BEST BY" October 2027 and lot codes BR-2026-01 and BR-2026-02 sold in Georgia and South Carolina due to unreported allergens [2]. Oysters from Little Wicomico Oyster Company in Virginia continue testing positive for Salmonella, with a third round of samples from November 2 showing contamination [7]. Sprouting seeds sold under Country Creek Acres and Francisco Family Foods brands have been recalled for possible Salmonella or E. coli contamination [10].
